description_en: Retrieves non-compliant resource information for a specified check item, including the name, ID, category, type, region, and related metadata of non-compliant resources
description_zh: 获取指定检测项的不合规资源信息，包含不合规资源的名称、ID、类别、类型、地域以及相关元数据
kebab_example: aliyun governance list-evaluation-metric-details --id xfyve50000 --account-id 1031445495680000 --next-token AAAAAGEaXR18y1rqykZHIqRuBejOqED4S3Xne33c7zbn0000 --max-results 5 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --snapshot-id es-bp1r00000000000000 --scope Account --date 2026-01-01 --evaluation-domain example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEvaluationMetricDetails

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the check item for which you want to retrieve non-compliant resources.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2841889.html operation to obtain the check item ID
parameters.help_zh:
需要获取不合规资源的检测项ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2841889.html接口，获取检测项ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member account. This parameter is applicable only to the multi-account check pattern
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号ID。该参数仅适用于多账号检测模式
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the next query
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in a single request. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 单次请求返回结果的最大条数。默认值：5
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The scope of the governance maturity check. Valid values:

- Account (default): queries the check item details for the current account.
- ResourceDirectory: queries the check item details for all member accounts in the resource directory. Before using this value, upgrade to multi-account governance maturity check
parameters.help_zh:
治理成熟度检测范围。取值：

- Account（默认）：查询当前账号的检测项明细。
- ResourceDirectory：查询资源目录所有成员账号的检测项明细。操作前，需要先升级至多账号治理成熟度检测
parameters.name: scope
